title: Reputation labels move in large, unpredictable jumps relative to the individual '(the X ±1)' deltas shown: the Ironbound went 'counted a brother' -> 'despised' (after exposing Preceptor Aldous at Cinderhall) -> back to 'neither friend nor foe' (after one favor at Fenmarch's mission), with no visible threshold a player could use to predict when a label would flip.
where: status screen, 'the Ironbound' line, Iron Downs through Fenmarch
